messages:
Claire (recruiting): quick ask — need an off-cycle comp elevation review for a senior ML infra candidate (Maya R.). moving EU -> US, manager Toni. competing offer on the table, want to extend verbal by EOD Fri. current band we planned: L5 mid; recruiting recommends uplift to hit market parity. drive memo: https://redwood.app/drive/comp-memos/MayaR. can we fast-track?

Sam - People Ops: thanks Claire — paste the comp breakdown here and upload the draft offer packet. note: uplift >15% requires comp committee signoff. tagging @Jordan (Comp) and @Toni. also add to offers tracker (https://redwood.app/offers/track) or run `/offer new`.

Claire (recruiting): numbers below: base current plan $200,000 -> requested $236,000 (+18%), equity 4% (4y), sign-on $15,000, relocation lump $10,000. total first-year cash + sign-on ~ $261k. candidate verbally prefers mid-May start, 2-week notice. tracker id: O-2026-231. brief rationale uploaded to drive link above.

Jordan (Comp): +18% is above typical band flex. proposal: approve a split option to reduce budget shock — +12% base (to $224k) + $10k sign-on (50% up front, 50% at 6mo), equity unchanged at 4%. this keeps retention and lowers run-rate churn. i'll draft committee memo. @Sam please loop finance for run-rate ack.

Toni (ENG-Mgr): strongly support. Maya's prior work on KV cache tuning directly maps to our perf targets; estimated inference cost reduction ~12% in our sim. we need to move fast. preferred start mid-May but flexible to late-May if approvals take longer.

offer-bot: Offer tracker updated — O-2026-231 status: committee_requested. link: https://redwood.app/offers/O-2026-231

Sam - People Ops: routing to comp committee now. committee meets tomorrow 09:30 PT. Jordan: please attach the committee memo using the template (/templates/comp_committee.md). cc finance (finance-ops@redwood.ai). if approved i'll prepare the admin-approved packet and onboarding checklist.

Jordan (Comp): pasted memo below:
```
Summary: risk of losing candidate to stealth competitor. Proposed approval: +12% base (to $224k) + $10k sign-on (50/50 payout), equity unchanged at 4%. Budget impact: FY27 run-rate +$80k. Decision requested: committee approval for uplift as proposed.
```

Sam - People Ops: finance ack received from Mia (finance) — incremental run-rate within hiring plan. moving to committee. cc @VP-people for awareness/expedite if needed.

Toni (ENG-Mgr): thanks — we'll hold the verbal at the proposed frame ($224k base + $10k sign-on) pending committee. candidate ok with that frame and confirmed interest.

Claire (recruiting): verbal accepted conditionally — candidate said "if comps align we'll sign". candidate prefers start 2026-05-12. i'll upload the draft offer packet once committee completes. thx everyone.

offer-bot: Committee outcome: APPROVED (2026-04-02 09:42:11 PT) — uplift approved as proposed. Offer packet generated: https://redwood.app/offers/O-2026-231/packet

Sam - People Ops: Approved. Claire — please proceed to extend the formal offer per packet. i'll kick off background check and onboarding tasks and post the onboarding checklist here when done. marking this thread resolved :white_check_mark:
